question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Ardent
solution:
The correct answer is** "Apathetic"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adjective **ardent** denotes **a high level of fervor, dedication, or enthusiasm**.

 
 
• ***Example:** Riya has never seen such an **ardent** pacifist as Joy.*
 
 
 
• **Apathy** is the absence of passion, interest, or care. The emotionless person is called **a****pathetic**.
 
 
• ***Example: **Some Americans are **apathetic**.*
 
 
 
• The definitions of ardent and apathetic are mutually exclusive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

Let's see the other words.

 
• To be **admirable** means to merit admiration or respect.
 
• Being **beautiful **refers to having an **appealing quality** that makes people happy when they see it or think about it.
 
• **Sincerity** is the absence of pretense or deception.
